bug_report: slugify is mangling product titles that contain symbols. 'R&D' slugifies to 'r-d' — the '&' is dropped entirely, which changed the search term and tanked the page's ranking. Symbols in titles (&, $, %) need to be preserved as the team's standard words in the slug, not stripped. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py. Fix boltons.strutils.slugify without breaking its existing behaviour.

conversations.text: Marketing flagged that several product pages with symbols in the title dropped out of search. slugify is stripping the symbols — 'R&D' becomes 'r-d'. We need the symbols to come through as words.

Looking at boltons/strutils.py — slugify calls split_punct_ws which discards punctuation, so '&', '$', '%' all vanish. Reproduced 'R&D' -> 'r-d'. I'll expand them to words before the split: '&' -> 'and', '$' -> 'dollar', '%' -> 'percent'. That gives 'r-and-d', 'usd'... wait, what wording do you want for currency and percent?

Not 'dollar' or 'percent' — we standardized on our analytics tags. '$' becomes 'usd' and '%' becomes 'pct'. So '$5 sale' -> 'usd-5-sale' and '50% off' -> '50-pct-off'. The ampersand is 'and' as you said.
Got it — the map is '&' -> 'and', '$' -> 'usd', '%' -> 'pct', matching the analytics tags, not the natural English words. Only those three symbols; leave the rest of the punctuation handling as-is.
Right. usd and pct, exactly. Ship it.

Done — slugify expands & -> and, $ -> usd, % -> pct before the existing split, so 'R&D' -> 'r-and-d', '$5 sale' -> 'usd-5-sale', '50% off' -> '50-pct-off'. Plain titles are unchanged and the strutils tests still pass.
